# Model seats

Run `swarm(action: "models", all: true)` before Step 3 to confirm live models and remaining quotas. Give each seat the cheapest model that meets its judgment bar: `gemini-4-carbon-high` for DAs, `gemini-4-neon-high` for design-and-build workers, and `gemini-4-hydrogen-high` for read-and-report streams (or `flash` for off-board `invoke_subagent` research helpers).

| Role | Dispatch | Model |
|---|---|---|
| DA | `swarm(action: "add", name: "da-M", model: "gemini-4-carbon-high", ...)` | `gemini-4-carbon-high` (hard judgment / review). Static `agents/adversarial-investigator.md` uses `inherit`. |
| Worker (design & build) | `swarm(action: "add", name: "worker-N", model: "gemini-4-neon-high", ...)` | `gemini-4-neon-high` (hard/medium design and implementation). Static `agents/orchestrate-worker.md` uses `pro`. |
| Read-and-report worker | `swarm(action: "add", name: "worker-N", model: "gemini-4-hydrogen-high", ...)` | `gemini-4-hydrogen-high` (read-and-cite streams with no code edits). |
| Evidence & Step 1 helpers | `invoke_subagent(TypeName: "research-delegate", Model: "flash", ...)` | `flash` off-board (`invoke_subagent` accepts only `inherit`/`pro`/`flash`/`flash_lite`; use `gemini-4-hydrogen-high` if spawning a helper on the swarm board). |

## Live model selection & quota switching

1. Call `swarm(action: "models", all: true)` to confirm `gemini-4-carbon-high`, `gemini-4-neon-high`, `gemini-4-hydrogen-high`, and live `quota_remaining`.
2. If a `waiting` worker hits quota or capacity limits, call `swarm(action: "model", name: "worker-N", model: "<alternate>")` and state why — never `kill` and re-`add` just to change models, as `model` preserves the worker's full conversation.
3. Keep `antigravity/agents/*.md` on Antigravity's static model tiers (`inherit`, `pro`, `flash`) because the plugin loader rejects full model IDs in agent frontmatter.
